parameters.query: with timeout_cfg as (select coalesce((select value::int from bot_settings where key='task_timeout_minutes'), 30) as timeout_min), stale_steps as (select s.task_id, s.step_no from bot_task_steps s, timeout_cfg cfg where s.status='running' and s.started_at < now() - make_interval(mins => cfg.timeout_min)), reset_steps as (update bot_task_steps s set status='pending', updated_at=now() from stale_steps st where s.task_id = st.task_id and s.step_no = st.step_no returning s.task_id, s.step_no), reset_tasks as (update bot_tasks t set status='failed_retryable', next_run_at=now(), last_error='Recovered stale running step after timeout', updated_at=now() from (select distinct task_id from stale_steps) st where t.id = st.task_id returning t.id) select rs.task_id, rs.step_no from reset_steps rs;

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { task_id: item.json.task_id, step_no: item.json.step_no, status: 'warning', message: 'Recovered stale running step and re-queued task for retry.' } }));
